tasks.requirements: Upgrade the application from .NET Framework 4.8 to .NET 8.0 LTS. This includes migrating from ASP.NET MVC 5 to ASP.NET Core MVC, converting the project file from legacy .csproj to SDK-style format, replacing packages.config with PackageReference, updating Global.asax startup to Program.cs/Startup.cs, migrating Web.config settings to appsettings.json, and updating all NuGet dependencies to .NET 8.0 compatible versions.

tasks.description: Migrate from MSMQ to Azure Service Bus
tasks.requirements: Replace MSMQ (System.Messaging) usage in NotificationService.cs with Azure Service Bus SDK (Azure.Messaging.ServiceBus). Migrate message queue creation, message sending, and message formatting from System.Messaging.MessageQueue to ServiceBusClient/ServiceBusSender. Use managed identity for authentication. Affected files: Services/NotificationService.cs (12 incidents).

tasks.description: Migrate from Windows Authentication to Azure App Service built-in auth (Easy Auth)
tasks.requirements: Replace Windows Authentication configuration with Azure App Service built-in authentication (Easy Auth). Configure Microsoft Entra ID as the identity provider. Update authentication and authorization middleware in the application. Remove Windows-specific authentication settings from configuration.

tasks.description: Migrate from local file system to Azure Blob Storage
tasks.requirements: Replace local file system operations (System.IO.File, System.IO.Directory) in Controllers/CoursesController.cs with Azure Blob Storage SDK (Azure.Storage.Blobs). Migrate file uploads, reads, deletions, and directory operations to use Azure Blob containers. Use managed identity for authentication. Affected files: Controllers/CoursesController.cs (8 incidents across lines 76, 78, 159, 161, 172, 174, 229, 233).

tasks.description: Migrate from Plaintext Credentials to Secured Credentials with Managed Identity and Azure KeyVault
tasks.requirements: Replace plaintext connection strings and app settings with Azure KeyVault references. Configure Managed Identity for secure credential access. Remove hardcoded secrets from configuration. Affected configuration: Web.config appSettings and connectionStrings sections (2 incidents).

tasks.description: Migrate from SQL Server to Managed Identity Based Azure SQL
tasks.requirements: Update database connection from local SQL Server to Azure SQL Database. Configure managed identity-based authentication replacing connection string credentials. Update Entity Framework DbContext connection configuration. Affected configuration: Web.config DefaultConnection (1 incident).

tasks.description: Migrate static content to Azure Blob Storage
tasks.requirements: Move static content files (16 files: CSS, JavaScript, images in Content/, Scripts/, Uploads/ directories) to Azure Blob Storage or Azure CDN for scalable serving. Update references in Views/Shared/_Layout.cshtml and other view files to point to the new Blob Storage URLs. Affected files: ContosoUniversity.csproj (1 incident - 16 static files detected).
